title: The Selfish Gene

blink.heading: The gene’s-eye view
blink.body: Bodies are vehicles built by genes to survive into the next generation. Reframe behaviour from here.

blink.heading: The meme
blink.body: Cultural ideas replicate too — and may not optimise for our benefit.

insights: We are survival machines — robot vehicles blindly programmed to preserve the selfish molecules known as genes.
highlights: We, alone on earth, can rebel against the tyranny of the selfish replicators.

flashcards.front: What is a meme, in Dawkins’ sense?
flashcards.back: A unit of cultural transmission — an idea, behaviour, or style that spreads by replication.
